specification_compliance: Answer to the review question: the diff reaches three places outside the touch-point list, all of them test files: lib/__tests__/appTargetDirectExclusions.test.ts (new), components/videoapp/__tests__/VideoApp.directTargetProviders.test.tsx (new) and lib/__tests__/readingAppTarget.test.ts (modified). Every product file and doc file in the diff (appTarget.ts, memberTarget.ts, videoAppTarget.ts, the three user guides and ADDON-DEVELOPMENT.md) is listed. docs/specs/* and INDEX.md are implicit.

Several listed touch points are not changed by this diff: the addons/knowledge tests, the submodule pointer and every component file. This matches the spec's plan, which says params are spread at those sites and the addon PR comes later.

I1 holds: every clause of hasImpossibleConditions (searchQuery.ts:538-576) needs a new-token field (excludedTags, noTag, notFavorite, notLiked, noCollection, excludedTypes, excludedFolders, excludedCollections). A query without a new token therefore reaches the same branches as before. resolveMemberTarget keeps free text as member (memberTarget.ts:89-92).

I2 and I7: resolveMemberTarget returns null for no text plus a new token, unless there is a duration and directDuration is false (memberTarget.ts:89-92). resolveVideoMemberTarget passes directDuration true (videoAppTarget.ts:90). resolveAppTarget still refuses duration and modified (appTarget.ts:93-95).

I3 at the request sites I sampled: restrict.ts:32-39 spreads ...target. The knowledge addon's notesConditions spreads target.params into its listing, tag-shelves and folder-counts requests (addons/knowledge/frontend/notesapp/listing.ts:42-46, 67-68, 87-88, 105-106).

I5: excluded kinds are removed from type (appTarget.ts:105-108). Video returns empty when an excluded kind holds video (videoAppTarget.ts:58-62). An impossible query returns empty with params null in both resolvers.
I9: the Discover cache key serialises the whole params object (discoverCache.ts:32, 53), so it includes the new keys.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: For a query with free text and an exclusion (e.g. 'cats -path:Work'), resolveAppTarget and resolveVideoTarget now return usable params carrying both search and exclude keys, where before they returned unsupported_part.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Every caller checks the member target first or ORs the two results (VideoAppHeader.tsx:15, useVideoApp.ts:172, readingAppTarget.ts:39, useNotesTarget.ts:230-231), so the user sees no difference.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: resolveVideoTarget calls hasImpossibleConditions(parsed) without folder.file_type, while resolveAppTarget passes it.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Video's separate excluded-kind and kinds checks give the same empty result for a fixed file_type, so the user sees nothing different.

regression_risks: Any request site in Video or Reading that copies named keys from the target params, rather than spreading them, would silently drop exclusions. I checked restrict.ts and the addon's listing.ts but did not audit every component listed in the touch points.

The member path for Notes and Clips relies on the two-argument call of resolveMemberTarget (directDuration defaults to false). A future caller that passes true while not sending duration would silently widen its results.
test_coverage: Resolver mutations I tried in my head are all caught: dropping the notFavorite, notLiked, has_tag, has_collection or exclude_* lines (caught by SINGLE_TOKENS / ALL_KEYS), dropping the excludedTypes filter on type (caught by the step 3 table), dropping hasImpossibleConditions from either resolver (caught by the IMPOSSIBLE tables), and flipping directDuration in resolveVideoMemberTarget (caught by the I7 resolver test).
The I5 Reading test asserts only that no request goes out. It does not check that the revised I5 'この対象は使えません' line is shown for an empty target.
Notes and Clips acceptance (I3, I6 and I7 in those apps) is not tested in this repository; the spec defers it to the addon PR (SPEC-ADDON-185).
